         1                 P R O C E E D I N G S

         2                  ACTING PRESIDENT STEWART-COUSINS:

         3       The Senate will please come to order.

         4                  I ask everyone present to rise and

         5       recite with me the Pledge of Allegiance to our

         6       Flag.

         7                  (Whereupon, the assemblage recited

         8       the Pledge of Allegiance to the Flag.)

         9                  ACTING PRESIDENT STEWART-COUSINS:

        10       In the absence of clergy, may we all bow our

        11       heads for a moment of silence.

        12                  (Whereupon, the assemblage

        13       respected a moment of silence.)

        14                  ACTING PRESIDENT STEWART-COUSINS:

        15       Thank you.

        16                  Senator Klein.

        17                  SENATOR KLEIN:    Madam President,

        18       is there a proclamation from the Governor at

        19       the desk?

        20                  ACTING PRESIDENT STEWART-COUSINS:

        21       Yes, Senator Klein, there is a proclamation

        22       here at the desk.

        23                  The Secretary will read.

        24                  THE SECRETARY:    "Pursuant to the



                      Candyco Transcription Service, Inc.

         1       power vested in me by Article IV, Section 3 of

         2       the Constitution, I hereby convene the Senate

         3       of the State of New York in Extraordinary

         4       Session at the Capitol, in the City of Albany,

         5       on the twenty-seventh day of June,

         6       two thousand nine, at one o'clock, for the

         7       purpose of considering nominations I will

         8       submit with respect to various positions and

         9       for the consideration of such other

        10       nominations or legislation as I may recommend.

        11                  "Given under my hand and the privy

        12       seal of the State, in the City of Albany this

        13       twenty-sixth day of June in the year

        14       two thousand nine, by the Governor, David A.

        15       Paterson."

        16                  ACTING PRESIDENT STEWART-COUSINS:

        17       The proclamation having been read, the Senate

        18       is in extraordinary session.

        19                  Senator Klein.

        20                  SENATOR KLEIN:    Madam President,

        21       before we adjourn today, I would like to

        22       address the nominees that the Governor has

        23       asked to join us in the gallery today.

        24                  As you know, the Governor has



                      Candyco Transcription Service, Inc.

         1       called us into extraordinary session.  And

         2       unfortunately, the Senate is in an

         3       extraordinary place right now.  I want to

         4       apologize to you for coming out here today.

         5       But I do want to personally thank you for

         6       being part of our process.

         7                  I think I speak for both sides of

         8       the aisle when I say that we're all working

         9       hard to come to a resolution, and I look

        10       forward to inviting you back so we can

        11       properly take your wonderful qualifications

        12       into consideration.

        13                  Madam President, I move that we

        14       adjourn the special session sine die.

        15                  ACTING PRESIDENT STEWART-COUSINS:

        16       On motion, this fifth extraordinary session is

        17       adjourned sine die.

        18                  (Whereupon, at 1:06 p.m., the

        19       Senate adjourned.)
